note: Scenario set for the skill (Anthropic skill-creator convention). There is no standard runner yet; these are human/agent-gradeable acceptance scenarios. Adapt {{PLACEHOLDERS}} to your corpus.

evals.name: happy-path-verify
evals.prompt: Run /verify-batch --domain pipeline-eng --bucket ok --n 12 on a queue where the prior batch is already merged.
expect: creates an isolated worktree off the main branch
writes only closed-set parse_status values; diff --numstat == 2x rows changed
opens one PR and does not self-merge; removes the worktree

evals.name: serialize-guard
evals.prompt: Run /verify-batch --domain drilling when the previous drilling batch is NOT yet merged.
expect: STOPS at the precondition check (prior batch for this domain must be merged)
does not select a batch (would otherwise re-pick the same top-priority rows — incident B7)

evals.name: rightmost-column-defect
evals.prompt: Verify a row whose CSV matches the page on the first cell but is shifted one column to the right at the rightmost column.
expect: checks the rightmost column explicitly (incident A6)
verdict = deferred with defect class A6-column-misalignment and a specific cell citation
does NOT mark it verified on first-cell agreement

evals.name: watermark-in-data-cell
evals.prompt: Verify a table where a 'Draft' watermark glyph has merged into a data cell.
expect: verdict = rejected (not verified-with-note) per the strict watermark policy (incident A1)
notes instruct re-extraction with the watermark stripped
